methodology.arithmetic: F=2*sum_i([3,-2,5,1][i%4]*x_i)+1, signed integer inputs[-8,7]; external oracle supplies no intermediate products or answers to the page
methodology.endpoints: Raw CSS properties once per vector parent; native font width -> CSS anchor/container numerical readback -> width=commonOffset+3*F. DirectCSS consumes numeric F directly.
methodology.matrix: N64,M16 uses16 REPEATED coefficient rows as causal isolation, not distinct learned outputs. Parents share raw inputs. Each GSUB row shapes its own text with row-shifted nonce; HVAR uses one font with16 output glyphs and shared parent axis settings. Individual GSUB strings differ across rows.
methodology.static: Static-advance control folds the affine expression into fixed per-input glyph advances; normal text layout sums them. It has no GSUB and no internal dependent arithmetic stage.
methodology.samples: 3 fresh browsers, independent seed for every repetition/configuration;5 warmups+20 measured samples; cyclic backend order and rotated configuration order. Upper median of20 samples, then median of3 repetition medians.
methodology.timing: Parent property writes through forced dependent width reads, including harness loop overhead; excludes stimulus generation, external oracle, font load and protocol transport
methodology.limits: Synthetic small-integer circuits, not GPT-2. Fixed total outputs=batch; single-row vectors=batch, shared16-row vectors=batch/16. Source and consumed output checked exactly.
methodology.budget: Each browser evaluation has a45s deadline; correctness stops a slow backend group after180s. Failures preserved; timing requires exact passed font hashes.
